data.body: **[P2] Do not reject records before exporter shaping.** This sizes the canonical record before any exporter's `render()` or truncation runs. A custom renderer may normalize a non-JSON value returned by a `ContentConfig` transform, and a canonical record over 16 MB may be reducible below the exporter's configured limit. These records previously reached per-exporter shaping but are now dropped by every lane, including terminal records. Base admission on a serialization-independent bounded estimate or an already shaped per-lane representation, and test both cases.
